Simulator

After being compiled, the Mini Program project automatically runs in the simulator and can be quickly previewed without using a mobile device. The basic interaction mode is to simulate finger tapping and dragging operations by clicking and dragging the mouse.

By default, the simulator is automatically refreshed each time the changed code is saved to implement real-time preview.

Simulator Startup

Choose Simulator from the navigation pane of the plugin tool directory.

Simulator Layout

By default, the simulator is opened in a separate window.

Functions on the Top of the Simulator (from Left to Right)

  • Device size: Select the preset iOS or Android device size to test the adaptability. In addition, user-defined devices are supported.
  • Zoom ratio: Control the zoom ratio of the Mini Program.
  • Simulation operations: Select the function to be simulated from the Operation drop-down list.
  • Gestures: Simulate finger tapping and dragging operations.
  • Refreshing: Recompile the code and refresh the simulator.
  • DevTools expanding or hiding: Click the icon to expand or hide the debugging tool. By default, the debugging tool is hidden.

Right Side of the Simulator

This area is the debugging tool, which works with the simulator to debug the Mini Program code.
